tasks.title: A number or a fallback
tasks.statement: Write a function safe_int(text, default=0): it converts a string to an integer, and if that fails, returns default. Use try/except ValueError.
tasks.hint: try: return int(text) / except ValueError: return default.

tasks.title: Safe division
tasks.statement: Write a function safe_divide(a, b): a / b, and None on division by zero.
tasks.hint: Catch exactly ZeroDivisionError and let everything else crash.

tasks.title: An age with validation
tasks.statement: Write a function parse_age(text): it returns an integer age from a string. If the number is negative, raise ValueError with any message. A non-numeric string will be rejected by int() itself.
tasks.hint: age = int(text); if age < 0: raise ValueError(...); return age.

tasks.title: A custom exception
tasks.statement: Define an exception NotEnoughMoney (a subclass of Exception) and a function withdraw(balance, amount): if amount is greater than balance, raise NotEnoughMoney with the message «не хватает <how much>», otherwise return the remainder.

tasks.title: The first number in a list
tasks.statement: Write a function first_int(items): items is a list of strings. Return the first value that can be converted to an integer (already as an int), or None if there is none.
tasks.hint: In a loop: try: return int(x) / except ValueError: continue; after the loop return None.

tasks.title: A log and finally
tasks.statement: Write a function process(items, log): append the string «start» to the list log; compute and return the list of 100 / x for each x in items; but if a zero is encountered, return None. In any case, even on error, append the string «end» to log at the very end (a finally block).
tasks.hint: try: return [100 / x for x in items] / except ZeroDivisionError: return None / finally: log.append('end').

tasks.title: A clear error
tasks.statement: Write a function get_port(config): it returns config["port"], and if the key is missing, raises RuntimeError("нет порта") FROM the original error (raise ... from e).
tasks.hint: try: return config["port"] / except KeyError as e: raise RuntimeError("нет порта") from e.

tasks.title: EAFP instead of get
tasks.statement: Write a function get_or_default(d, key, default): the value for the key, or default. You may not use the get method or the word in, only try/except KeyError.
tasks.hint: try: return d[key] / except KeyError: return default.
